method.training: Qualified measured primary tides in completed calendar years after the first partial archive year; probability fitted by calendar month and standardized by expected astronomical tide exposure. Unobserved cycles are not zeros. Current partial year, backup estimates and selected official-crest supplements excluded.
method.detrending: measured height - independent relative-sea-level trend * (event decimal year - 2026)
method.futureFit: Month-stratified empirical detrended high-tide exceedance, weighted by full-calendar expected tide exposure, under existing gauge sea-level scenarios.
method.uncertainty: Analytical binomial planning approximation using seasonally standardized annual probabilities. Exact binomial marginal quantiles conditional on that iid approximation; total intervals use total exceedance probability, never sums of category intervals. Excludes storm clustering, probability-estimation uncertainty, and sea-level-scenario uncertainty.
method.annualDraws: Median full-calendar expected predicted-high count in completed training years; fixed annual planning draw count.
method.bins: Exclusive minor/moderate/major; total equals their sum.
